summary.text: If you cannot afford your premiums, you can use MediSave, top up with cash, or ask family to help. Additional support is also available.

details.heading: Using MediSave and cash
details.body: MediShield Life premiums are fully payable by MediSave. If there are insufficient monies in the MediSave account, policyholders can top up their account with cash or their family members with sufficient MediSave balance can step in to support their premium payments.

details.heading: Additional Premium Support
details.body: Additional Premium Support (APS) is available for those who face difficulty paying for premiums even after Government subsidies and MediSave use, and have limited family support.

details.heading: Coverage guarantee
details.body: No one will lose coverage from MediShield Life because of an inability to pay their premiums.
